explication: Canvas is an open-source learning management system. Its broad product surface includes course participation, assignments and grading, content and files, accessibility, activity reporting, and integrations. The sampled frontend paths show two concrete user-facing flows: the gradebook assembles course data from focused queries, while file preview resolves a URL-selected file, fetches it when it is not already in the collection, and updates preview state. The repository tree documents many additional domain areas, but the excerpts do not establish their runtime connections; those are represented as capabilities rather than a guessed end-to-end pipeline.
